rule: Anonymous subclass instantiation (`new Iface() {…}`, Scala `new Trait {…}`): no constructor edge when the named type is an interface/trait (it has no constructor); when it is a class (including abstract), `Type#<init>`, constructor, as usual. Calls inside the body fold into the enclosing function as before.
notes: `new class (5) extends BaseJob` instantiates an anonymous subclass of an (abstract) class → App.BaseJob#<init>, constructor, high (BaseJob defines __construct); line = the line naming BaseJob. `new class implements Handler` names only an interface → no constructor edge. Members of both anonymous classes fold into App.Factory#make. Inside the anonymous subclass, $this->log() is defined only on the scanned superclass → App.BaseJob#log. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (instance and static member calls) and direct for free functions, bare names and named nested functions.
